attribution_approval.name: attribution_approval
attribution_approval.value: ("memory_attribution_corrections"."state"='applied' AND "memory_attribution_corrections"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "memory_attribution_corrections"."approved_by"="memory_attribution_corrections"."owner" AND "memory_attribution_corrections"."applied_at" IS NOT NULL AND "memory_attribution_corrections"."cancelled_at" IS NULL) OR ("memory_attribution_corrections"."state"='proposed' AND "memory_attribution_corrections"."approved_by" IS NULL AND "memory_attribution_corrections"."applied_at" IS NULL AND "memory_attribution_corrections"."cancelled_at" IS NULL) OR ("memory_attribution_corrections"."state"='cancelled' AND "memory_attribution_corrections"."approved_by" IS NULL AND "memory_attribution_corrections"."applied_at" IS NULL AND "memory_attribution_corrections"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL)

memory_contribution_approval.name: memory_contribution_approval
memory_contribution_approval.value: ("memory_contributions"."state"='proposed' AND "memory_contributions"."applied_at" IS NULL) OR ("memory_contributions"."state"='applied' AND "memory_contributions"."applied_at" IS NOT NULL AND "memory_contributions"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL)
